entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: The imperial champion of Madara, who is made subordinate to Elsdragon, grows disgusted with Overdark and the emperor, and renounces his title.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: The imperial assassin of Madara, ordered to stay out of the Edemi campaign, who schemes to control the Kentsu and is made imperial regent by Bolas.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: The highest general of the Kentsu, charged by the emperor with conquering the Edemis; he is decapitated by Hage.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The godlike emperor of Madara, revealed to be the planeswalker and Elder Dragon Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: An Ærathi brute, second in command of the Kentsu, secretly Overdark's minion; he kills Elsdragon and seizes the title of highest general.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Tetsuo's armorer, who develops an addiction to Kushoan blue mana and leads an attack on the Sylvan Library.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: A Bogardan firemage on a pilgrimage toward the seventh circle of mages, who serves the Kentsu as demolition expert.

entities.name: Gosta Dirk
entities.description: Leader of Kusho's defenders, who evacuates the island and falls terminally ill from mana poisoning.

entities.name: Ramirez DePietro
entities.description: A figure who helps Ayesha escape and protects hidden Kushoans; he is later revealed to be the shapeshifter Halfdane in disguise.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Tetsuo's healer, mutated into a half eumidian, who is mortally wounded by Halfdane and uses his last power to heal Tor.

entities.name: Tor Wauki
entities.description: A rebel-allied companion of Tetsuo and Kei, left on Kusho and later poisoned by Xira Arien.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: The Nekoru defender of the village of Sekana, who lets the Kentsu pass if they keep away from her newborn kittens.

entities.name: Barktooth Warbeard
entities.description: A Kentsu marshal who leads the third fleet and occupies Kusho; his troops suspect he is going senile.

entities.name: Lady Caleria
entities.description: The ruler of Argenti, who cast the Greater Realm of Preservation and holds her castle against the Kentsu.

entities.name: Lord Magnus
entities.description: A lord of Argenti connected to the Sylvan Library whom Ayesha's attack is meant to distract.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: An agent of Overdark who appears on Argenti and later attacks and poisons Tor.

entities.name: Lady Orca
entities.description: A creature sent by Overdark who defeats the Akron and breaks Caleria's wall, then turns on the Kentsu; Tetsuo destroys her lair, killing her.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: A shapeshifter who posed as Ramirez, Warbeard and Tor, and mortally wounds Kei.

entities.name: The Kentsu
entities.description: The brutal imperial army of Madara, sent to conquer the Edemi Islands.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: The empire ruled by the godlike emperor, who is revealed as Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: The Edemi Islands
entities.description: A defiant island chain in rebellion against the emperor.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: An Edemi island that must be taken but not razed; it is corrupted by non-native black mana sources.

entities.name: Argenti
entities.description: An Edemi island that can be obliterated, guarded by the Greater Realm of Preservation and ruled from the city of Lisu.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: A library on Argenti that Ayesha takes in hopes of curing her mana addiction.

entities.name: Greater Realm of Preservation
entities.description: A spell cast by Lady Caleria that surrounds Argenti and prevents black or red mana creatures from damaging each other; the emperor destroys it by blinking.

events.summary: The emperor charges Elsdragon with conquering the Edemis and punishes Umezawa and Overdark, placing Umezawa under Elsdragon and keeping Overdark out of the campaign.
events.quote: He charges Elsdragon with conquering the Edemis.

events.summary: The Kentsu strike Kusho; Ayesha is captured by Gosta's defenders and escapes with Ramirez's help.
events.quote: Ayesha is captured by the island's defenders

events.summary: Meha creates a chasm to block Kushoan reinforcements, and Hage, who wanted to slaughter them, nearly kills Meha as punishment.
events.quote: Meha creates a chasm to prevent Kushoan reinforcements from reaching the battle.

events.summary: Tetsuo and Kei go to Sekana, where the Nekoru Wasitora agrees to let the Kentsu pass if they avoid her kittens.
events.quote: She will if the soldiers stay well away from her newborn kittens.

events.summary: Elsdragon lands on Kusho and finds it nearly empty; Gosta was only buying time to evacuate.
events.quote: Gosta was only fighting the Kentsu to buy enough time to evacuate the island.

events.summary: Elsdragon, Tetsuo and Overdark meet on the Meditation Plane and invoke the emperor, who destroys the Greater Realm of Preservation just by blinking.
events.quote: Elsdragon and Tetsuo meet Overdark on the Meditation Plane and the three of them invoke the emperor, who destroys the Realm just by blinking.

events.summary: Ayesha takes the Sylvan Library to distract Magnus and tries to contact Kei.
events.quote: Ayesha takes the library and tries to contact Kei.

events.summary: The Kentsu and Caleria's undying troops fight to a stalemate and Caleria withdraws to her castle, where Elsdragon begins a siege.
events.quote: Caleria decides to hide back in her castle and Elsdragon begins a siege

events.summary: Warbeard torches an evergreen tree so the rebels cannot communicate, then gives Kei and Tor vague orders to wander the island.
events.quote: Warbeard tells them he knew the tree could be used by Magnus to contact Gosta

events.summary: Overdark sends Lady Orca to help; she destroys the Akron and Caleria's wall, then turns on the Kentsu.
events.quote: The Kentsu soldiers cheer, but then Orca turns around and attacks them!

events.summary: Kei and Tor find Gosta's hidden lair, where he is terminally ill from mana poisoning, and meet Ramirez.
events.quote: Kei and Tor find the hidden lair of Gosta Dirk, who is now terminally ill from the mana poisoning of Kusho.

events.summary: Tetsuo destroys Orca's lair, killing her.
Overdark reveals that he controls Hage, who decapitates Elsdragon and seizes the title of highest general of the Kentsu.
events.quote: Overdark reveals that he controls Hage, and orders the Ærathi to decapitate Elsdragon and seize the title of highest general of the Kentsu.

events.summary: Tetsuo teleports himself and Meha away from Argenti.
events.quote: sees the chaos, and teleports Meha and himself away from Argenti.

events.summary: Halfdane, who had posed as Tor, mortally wounds Kei and Xira poisons Tor.
events.quote: Halfdane mortally wounds Kei, and Xira poisons Tor.

events.summary: Kei uses his last power to heal Tor.
events.quote: Kei uses his last power to heal Tor.

events.summary: Disgusted by Overdark, Tetsuo renounces his claim to the title of imperial champion.
events.quote: Now Tetsuo finally makes a decision and renounces his claim to the title of champion.

events.summary: The emperor reveals himself as Nicol Bolas and makes Overdark imperial regent.
events.quote: He makes Overdark the imperial regent

relations.quote: the highest general of the Kentsu, Marhault Elsdragon
his nemesis, the imperial champion Tetsuo Umezawa
Overdark reveals that he controls Hage

relations.note: Hage decapitates Elsdragon on Overdark's order.
relations.quote: orders the Ærathi to decapitate Elsdragon

relations.note: Tetsuo destroys Orca's lair, killing her.
Ramirez was a disguise of the shapeshifter Halfdane.
Overdark is the emperor's imperial assassin, later made imperial regent.
relations.quote: He makes Overdark the imperial regent
